description:
FILED s543 by the reviewing session (2026-11-22, evening), review probes of s543h (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1122/rh3 c-10).  PRE-EXISTING on main b58114ca; the same on s543h's and s543i's trees.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40 | ./runpcl on main):
    our %h = (k => "m");
    { local ${h}{k} = "L"; print "E: $h{k}\n"; } print "F: $h{k}\n";
    # perl: E: L / F: m
    # PCL:  Undefined subroutine &main::h called at x.pl line 2.
    my $r = eval('package Bar; local ${h}{k} = "L"; "$h{k}"');     # the same die, &Bar::h

WHAT IT IS: under `local` the `${h}` of `${h}{k}` is read as a BLOCK calling `h()`; the element READ `${h}{k}` is right, and so is `local @{a} = (5,6)`.  LOUD, so behind the silent wrongs; it hides #5371's element face.

FIX DIRECTION: the `local` plan (s543g: the target is the LAST subscript) should see a brace NAME through Parser2::_brace_name_refs like the read does -- not a second reader.  `${h}[0]` likewise.


=== NOTE (s543j, 2026-11-22) -- what #5001's hoist does with the brace spelling ===
`my $t = delete local ${h}{b};`: the #3370 hoist DECLINES the operand (Parser2::_local_operand refuses a bareword inside the deref block -- it would read as a call), and, being the declaration's direct operand, the statement keeps the seam's lowering: silent `2 a a` as on main (perl `2 a a,b`; the restore is lost).  `local ${h}{b} = 7` itself dies as filed.  s543j changed neither.


=== DONE (s543l) ===
Measured: Pl::Stmt::local_shape read `local ${h}{k}` as a CAST base whose Block the plan lowered as an expression
(the bareword `h` = a call of h()); `local ${v}` / `@{a}` / `%{h}` were the deref plan's SYMBOLIC
`(p-local-deref-* "v")`, resolved in the CURRENT package at run time -- in eval text behind `package Bar;` that is
Bar's variable while the read `${v}` (PExpr's collapse) is the site's `our` (#5371).
Fix (Pl/): Pl::Stmt::brace_names_plain reads every brace NAME of a `local` target run through the ONE brace-name
reader, Parser2::brace_name_of (the per-block body of _brace_name_refs: the binder, the span renamer and the region
requalifier read it), and puts the plain spelling's token in place of the Cast + Block (PExpr::plain_name_token, the
read collapse's own builder).  Applied where every `local` path reads its target: the statement run (local_shape,
which local_delete_shape gets), a parenthesised single target (local_paren_unwrap), a list's groups
(local_list_groups).  The #3370 hoist's operand reader (_local_operand) accepts a brace name and counts its variable.
So the target is resolved exactly as the plain spelling (#5371 needs no change in the resolver: the plain `local $v`
was right).  Probes scratch/s543l/probes/m1 (25: base 8 -> tree 25) and m1b (15: base 4 -> tree 15): the three
sigils, an element, a slice, `${h}{a}{b}`, `delete local ${h}{k}` statement and term (the restore lost silently on
the base), `local ${1}` (died on the base), `$#{a}`, a `my %h` element, the eval / `our` faces; the breaking shapes
(`${ $r }{k}`, `${ f() }{k}`, `${"h"}{k}`, `${Pkg::h}{k}`, a hard ref dying) unchanged.  Guards local-elem-02.t N1-N3,
eval-capture-01.t blocal_s / blocal_e / blocal_h / blocal_a; local-symref-01.t's transpile row ('local ${aa} emits
p-local-deref-scalar') rewritten to 'emits exactly what local $aa emits'.  Filed #5382 (DROP: `local ${h{k}}`, the
subscripted brace spelling).


FINAL SHA (s543l, 2026-11-27): the batch is MERGE-READY at 2f85209e, rebased onto main 4b0d5d50 (its code = s543m final 5d426786 + this batch; the review fix L1 for #5333 is 6a1301ed); the notes above cite pre-rebase shas.
